sources.title: Google Gemma 3 4B IT model repository
sources.evidence: Exact instruction-tuned 4B repository, based on google/gemma-3-4b-pt; identifies Gemma license and demonstrates image/text input with text generation. Reopened for the October 27 parameter pass: the official model tree explicitly identifies google/gemma-3-4b-pt as the base and this checkpoint as its fine-tune.

sources.title: Introducing Gemma 3
sources.evidence: Dated March 12, 2025 launch announces 1B, 4B, 12B and 27B models available for download; explicitly reports function calling and structured output.

sources.title: Gemma 3 model card
sources.evidence: Identifies Google authorship, open pretrained and instruction-tuned weights; 4B accepts text/images and produces text with 128K combined context. Reports ordinary reasoning benchmarks, without establishing a dedicated thinking-mode boolean. Fresh parameter review found no separately defined active count for the exact 4B IT variant.

sources.title: Gemma 3 Technical Report, March 12, 2025
sources.evidence: Exact 4B-IT is discussed. Section 2 describes decoder-only Transformer with GQA, RMSNorm, QK normalization and 5:1 local/global attention. Table 1 lists rounded 4B components: vision 417M, embeddings 675M, non-embeddings 3,209M. Vision encoder is shared and frozen during language-model training; no active-parameter count is defined. Freshly reread Section 3 explicitly turns the pretrained models into instruction-tuned models through post-training, including teacher knowledge distillation and reinforcement learning; this does not identify a newly resized student, pruning, expert expansion or added modality between the named 4B PT and IT checkpoints. The teacher is not used as the size source.

sources.title: Exact official checkpoint metadata
sources.evidence: Public model API reports safetensors.parameters.BF16=4,300,079,472 and safetensors.total=4,300,079,472 for this exact repository revision; architecture Gemma3ForConditionalGeneration. Aggregate checkpoint metadata was read, not tensor headers. Re-fetched October 27: the same count and architecture remain, and cardData.base_model explicitly names google/gemma-3-4b-pt; its matching pinned metadata is s17.

sources.title: Official Gemma 3 Orbax to Transformers converter
sources.evidence: Exact gemma3_4b branch: 34 layers, width 2560, MLP 10240, 8 query/4 KV heads, head width 256 and original vocabulary 262144; vision dimensions 1152/4304/27 layers/896 pixels/14 patch. Conversion appends 64 statistically initialized embedding rows, increases vocabulary by 64 and ties the output head. These added rows are not original learned embeddings.

sources.title: Transformers Gemma 3 implementation
sources.evidence: Defines dense attention and MLP weights, four hidden-width norms and two head-width QK norms per text layer, final text norm and tied output embedding. Projector is 1152x2560 plus a 1152-element RMSNorm, with parameter-free average pooling.

sources.title: Google SigLIP vision implementation
sources.evidence: Vision parameters comprise patch convolution with bias, learned positional embedding, 27 Transformer blocks with biased attention/MLP and LayerNorms, and final LayerNorm. Position IDs are a nonpersistent buffer; average pooling has no learned parameters.

sources.title: Transformers Gemma 3 configuration
sources.evidence: Gemma3TextConfig sets max_position_embeddings=131072 and tie_word_embeddings=true; these defaults apply to the exact converter branch. The multimodal vocabulary has 262208 entries after conversion.

sources.title: Gemma Terms of Use
sources.evidence: Custom Gemma Terms of Use expressly list Gemma 3 in their applicability appendix; the exact weight card labels the license gemma.

sources.title: Google ADK Gemma 3 function-calling adapter
sources.evidence: Explains Gemma 3 lacks native function calling, implements tool definitions in prompts and parses generated function calls, and explicitly lists gemma-3-4b-it among supported model examples. Recommends larger 12B/27B models for agentic use.

sources.title: Exact official checkpoint file history
sources.evidence: Official config, index and both BF16 shards carry March 12, 2025 commit dates, corroborating launch-day availability of the exact IT variant.

sources.title: Official checkpoint tensor-header access attempt
sources.evidence: An 8-byte Range request returned HTTP 401 because this repository requires authenticated license access. Official raw config/index are similarly gated; no weight shard was downloaded.

sources.title: Google Gemma 3 4B reference configuration
sources.evidence: The get_config_for_4b branch independently matches 34 layers, 2560 hidden width, 10240 MLP width, 8 query heads, 4 KV heads, 256 head width and original 262144 vocabulary with quantization disabled by default.

sources.title: Gemma release chronology
sources.evidence: Current chronology lists March 10, 2025 for Gemma 3, conflicting with the contemporaneous March 12 announcements and technical report. Retain the contemporaneous launch date.

sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report, Table 7
sources.evidence: Freshly read the original research-team comparison. Table 7 explicitly identifies Gemma-3-4B Base as dense and lists 4B total and 4B activated parameters. This is Qwen Team's nominal comparison convention, not a separate Google disclosure or exact inference-time tensor count. The exact 4B IT model appears elsewhere in benchmark results without its own activated-count table row. Google explicitly identifies that PT checkpoint as the IT model's base, with matching released metadata and no supported structural resizing (s1, s4, s5, s17).

sources.title: Pinned Google Gemma 3 4B PT base metadata
sources.evidence: Freshly fetched official named-base metadata reports Gemma3ForConditionalGeneration and 4,300,079,472 BF16 parameters, matching the exact IT metadata. This corroborates the explicit PT-to-IT relationship, rather than transferring a count from an unexamined sibling. Aggregate metadata only; no weights downloaded.

sources.title: Kimi-VL Technical Report, Figure 1
sources.evidence: Opened the original HTML paper, downloaded its original arXiv PDF and visually inspected page 1. Figure 1 explicitly labels Gemma-3-4B-IT on an activated-parameters axis at roughly 4B. The approximate plot corroborates the nominal convention for the exact IT model; it does not establish an exact count or Gemma-specific component scope. The caption's language-decoder qualification for Kimi-VL is not transferred to Gemma.

sources.title: Gemma 4 Technical Report, later comparison check
sources.evidence: Freshly checked later Google architecture, parameter and Gemma 3 comparison passages. Its 3.8B active statement concerns Gemma 4 26B-A4B, not Gemma 3 4B IT; it supplies no retrospective active-count definition for this exact model. The current Gemma 4 model card was also checked with the same distinction.

name.note: Exact 4B instruction-tuned model; IT means instruction-tuned, distinct from PT and later quantized/QAT variants.

developer.note: Google DeepMind is the authoring organization; Google matches the catalog developer label.

family.note: Gemma 3 belongs to the Gemma family.

release_date.note: Google announced availability March 12, 2025; exact IT config and weight-shard history corroborates this day. The later release log says March 10; this conflict is recorded rather than silently backdating the model.

open_weights.note: Google distributes the instruction-tuned checkpoint under its Gemma terms; authentication/license gating does not make weights closed.

license.note: Custom Gemma license, identified as gemma on the weight card. The software implementation Apache license does not replace the model license.

parameters_b.note: Complete released HF checkpoint count from aggregate BF16 metadata, independently reconciled to exact converter and architecture: text 3,880,263,168 + vision 416,866,032 + projector 2,950,272 = 4,300,079,472. Tied output embeddings count once. Includes 64 conversion-created vocabulary rows (163,840 values); original implementation count is 4,299,915,632. These added entries are not original learned weights. No packed quantization or scale tensors enter the formula; positional/RoPE buffers and pooling are excluded. Raw headers were gated: this is metadata-plus-implementation reconciliation, not a direct header census. The 4B label is nominal. Fresh October 27 pinned metadata reconfirms this total; the 4B PT base has the same aggregate count. The supported exact count and existing derivation are retained without a repeated tensor census.

active_parameters_b.note: Nominal 4B under Qwen Team's published activated-parameter convention for Gemma-3-4B Base, applied by explicit PT-to-IT lineage: Google identifies the exact PT checkpoint as the base, describes post-training of pretrained models, and both released checkpoint metadata totals and architectures match. No structural resizing, pruning or expert expansion of this named student was established. Kimi Team's original Figure 1 also plots the exact Gemma-3-4B-IT at roughly 4B on an activated-parameters axis. This is an attributed nominal research-comparison convention, not a separately defined Google active disclosure or exact per-token census. Neither comparison defines Gemma-specific component scope; vision/projector participation varies with input and phase, so the exact 4.300079472B total is not copied into active. Fresh exact-model/base searches and later Google Gemma 4 comparison checks found no more precise exact-model active definition.

architecture.note: Dense decoder-only language Transformer with GQA and interleaved local/global attention, plus SigLIP vision Transformer and multimodal projector; no expert router or MoE layers.

context_window.note: Google documents 128K combined input/output context for 4B; exact 4B converter inherits max_position_embeddings=131072 from Gemma3TextConfig. This is the documented window, not extrapolated RoPE capacity.

modalities.note: 4B-IT supports text/image input and text output. Video frames can be supplied as images; no native audio or generated image output is established.

reasoning.note: Sources document general reasoning performance and standard instruction-tuned generation, but do not explicitly establish the catalog dedicated-reasoning/thinking-mode boolean for this exact 4B-IT checkpoint. Clear unsupported baseline false rather than infer from ordinary benchmarks or absent control tokens.

tool_call.note: Retain source-reported function-calling capability. Google ADK explicitly supports 4B-IT through prompting and response parsing; Gemma 3 lacks native function-call protocol support. This boolean does not claim a native API tool-call channel.

patch.description: Google's instruction-tuned Gemma 3 model with text and image input and text output.
patch.notes: Total 4.300079472B includes language, vision and projector weights, with tied embeddings counted once and 163,840 entries added during Hugging Face conversion. Active 4B is nominal under Qwen Team's published base-model convention, supported by Google's explicit PT-to-IT lineage and Kimi Team's approximate exact-IT comparison plot; it is not an exact per-token count or a separate Google active disclosure. Function calling uses prompting and output parsing. The March 12 launch announcement conflicts with a later release log saying March 10.

summary: Fresh parameter re-audit retains the complete released checkpoint total of 4.300079472B, reconfirmed by pinned official metadata without repeating the prior census or downloading weights. Recover nominal active 4B from Qwen Team's explicit base-model comparison convention through Google's named PT-to-IT relationship and matching checkpoint metadata; Kimi Team's original Figure 1 independently corroborates roughly 4B for the exact IT model. Attribute the convention to those research teams, not Google, and do not invent component scope or exact per-token participation. Original evidence, exact-model and named-base searches, and later Google comparisons were revisited; no more precise active definition was found. Preserve all other field assessments and the prior exact count derivation.
